schedule: All batch64 screens run first. Each cell has one warmup and three scored runs per arm, with alternating order, 30 seconds initial cooldown and five seconds between invocations. Point guards run only if every batch screen qualifies. No score-selected replacement runs.
ranking: Highest eligible throughput per exact binary and workload; p99, syncs, frontiers, coalesce waits and grouping counts come from that same invocation. Report unfiltered samples too.

stall_filter.selection: Flag each run using mean times; passing means can still hide brief SSD stalls.

constraints: Baseline is the exact previously measured dynamic grouping binary.

Candidate appends canonical multi-entry logical bytes to an already-reserved vector rather than zero-filling its data range. Single-entry encoding, CRC domains, wire bytes, v4 behavior, DATA grouping, and sync policy are unchanged.
All scratch databases remain inside the local repository.
Do not qualify a performance win from insufficient eligible samples.
